proof_body:
by
  have nrm2 : ∀ z : Zsqrtd (-5), z.norm ≠ 2 := by
    intro z hz
    have h : z.re * z.re + 5 * (z.im * z.im) = 2 := by
      have := hz
      rw [Zsqrtd.norm_def] at this
      linarith
    have h1 : z.im * z.im = 0 := by nlinarith [mul_self_nonneg z.re, mul_self_nonneg z.im]
    have h2 : z.re * z.re = 2 := by
      rw [h1] at h
      linarith
    have h3 : z.re ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
    have h4 : -1 ≤ z.re := by nlinarith
    generalize z.re = r at *
    interval_cases r <;> omega
  have hnorm2 : Zsqrtd.norm (2 : Zsqrtd (-5)) = 4 := by decide
  constructor
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      have := (Zsqrtd.isUnit_iff_norm_isUnit (2 : Zsqrtd (-5))).mp h
      rw [hnorm2] at this
      exact absurd this (by decide)
    · intro a b hab
      have hn : a.norm * b.norm = 4 := by rw [← Zsqrtd.norm_mul, ← hab, hnorm2]
      have ha : 0 ≤ a.norm := Zsqrtd.norm_nonneg (by norm_num) a
      have hb : 0 ≤ b.norm := Zsqrtd.norm_nonneg (by norm_num) b
      have hbpos : 0 < b.norm := by
        rcases hb.lt_or_eq with h | h
        · exact h
        · rw [← h] at hn
          simp at hn
      have ha4 : a.norm ≤ 4 := by nlinarith
      have ha2 := nrm2 a
      have hb2 := nrm2 b
      have hcases : a.norm = 1 ∨ b.norm = 1 := by
        generalize a.norm = u at *
        generalize b.norm = v at *
        interval_cases u
        · simp at hn
        · left
          rfl
        · exact absurd rfl ha2
        · omega
        · right
          omega
      rcases hcases with h | h
      · left
        exact (Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff' (by norm_num) a).mp h
      · right
        exact (Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff' (by norm_num) b).mp h
  · intro hp
    have hprod : (⟨1, 1⟩ : Zsqrtd (-5)) * ⟨1, -1⟩ = 2 * 3 := by
      ext <;> simp
    rcases hp.2.2 _ _ ⟨3, hprod⟩ with ⟨c, hc⟩ | ⟨c, hc⟩
    · have := congrArg Zsqrtd.im hc
      simp at this
      omega
    · have := congrArg Zsqrtd.im hc
      simp at this
      omega
